page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on x86_64 architecture using dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors clocked at 2.5 GHz. It features 16 physical cores supporting 32 vCPUs via multithreading, alongside 64 GB of system memory at a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio (2.0 GB per core). The CPU configuration includes 35 MB of L3 cache and supports instruction set extensions such as AVX-512 with VNNI for vectorized execution and neural network inference workloads. The instance does not include local storage or discrete GPU accelerators, relying on cloud storage attachments, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps managed under a KVM hypervisor.

In performance testing, the instance displays moderate multi-threaded capacity alongside slower single-threaded throughput. Benchmark metrics show single-core CPU performance in stress-ng and single-threaded gzip compression landing in the lower percentile ranges, reflecting modest base clock speeds per core. However, multi-core benchmarks—including stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core scores, bzip3 multi-threaded decompression, and PassMark CPU metrics—fall within average target ranges across comparable cloud hardware. Memory bandwidth tests for both small cached blocks and large uncached allocations similarly demonstrate steady average performance.

From a resource density and cost efficiency perspective, the instance provides high parallel compute capacity for scale-out workloads without incurring costs for local ephemeral disks or dedicated accelerators. The absence of integrated NVMe storage requires external disk provision for persistent IO operations. The instance is well-matched for parallel compute jobs, batch processing, static web serving, software compilation with compilers like Clang, and Redis caching layers where multi-core execution and network throughput take priority over extreme single-threaded velocity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6.8xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processors running at 2.5 GHz on x86_64 architecture. The server features 16 physical cores supporting 32 vCPUs alongside 64 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio (2.0 GB per vCPU). CPU specifications include a 35 MB L3 cache and support for instruction set extensions like AVX-512 and VNNI. Local storage is omitted, and the instance includes no GPU accelerators, using a 10 Gbps baseline network link for attached network storage under KVM virtualization. Benchmark evaluations indicate average multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and web serving throughput, against weaker single-core processing scores in single-threaded tests. This hardware configuration offers an efficient compute-dense footprint for parallelized workloads, batch processing pipelines, software compilation using Clang, static web serving, and Redis key-value memory stores.
